items.title: CVS Health Raises Earnings Outlook, but the Stock Is Falling
items.summary: CVS Health  stock was sinking even after the healthcare giant raised its full-year guidance on the back of second-quarter earnings that handily beat analysts’ projections.  While analysts reacted positively to the earnings announcement, company executives spoke in more detail on an investor call about sources of pressure during the quarter—including from a federal drug pricing program called 340B.  For the second quarter, CVS Health posted adjusted earnings of $2.58 a share.
